items.message: The `use()` method calls `strategy()` (instantiating the class with no arguments) when passed a type, then calls `complete(self)` where `complete` is `adapter.complete_for`. The `complete_for` method receives the full `Lockstep` instance, giving it access to `lockstep.policy`, `lockstep.repo`, `lockstep.container`, and any other module-level state. If a third-party or user-supplied strategy subclass overrides `complete_for`, it can read and mutate arbitrary Lockstep state during what appears to …[truncated]

In `complete_for`, the WorktreeRunner wrap is applied only when `self.commands is not None`. When `self.commands` is None and `workshop` is also None (or `workshop.commands` is None), the method returns the `request` type without setting a runner, which is the documented safe default.
